setup_speech_dlm_task: setup a SpeechDLMTask by loading channel dictionaries and configuring next, edge, and duration prediction targets
load_speech_dlm_dataset: load a SpeechDLMDataset split for training or validation with token block and monolingual dataset wrappers
build_speech_dlm_generator: build a MultichannelSequenceGenerator with beam search or sampling strategy for multichannel speech DLM inference
build_inference_dataset: build a NestedDictionaryDataset for inference by prepending BOS/EOS tokens and appending pad tokens per channel
run_speech_dlm_inference: run inference step with prefix tokens and a MultichannelSequenceGenerator to generate multichannel speech sequences
